item.text:
**Narendra Modi, 2024, lens 8B.6**

Bottom line: Modi’s 2024 record is mixed. There is real evidence of implementation in bureaucratic and welfare channels, but the strongest counterevidence shows that campaign politics remained heavy on propaganda, information control, and coercive state responses. Most positive items below are official self-reports, so they are weaker than the Reuters/HRW counterevidence.

**Selected Evidence**
- **With renewed focus on next generation administrative reforms...** — Press Information Bureau / Ministry of Personnel, Public Grievances & Pensions, **18 Jan 2024**. URL: [PIB](https://www.pib.gov.in/PressReleaseIframePage.aspx?PRID=1997326&lang=2&reg=48). Claim: the government approved funding for AI-assisted CPGRAMS and last-mile service delivery, showing a concrete administrative mechanism rather than a slogan-only promise. QIDs: `8B.6`
- **Reforms in CPGRAMS** — Press Information Bureau / Ministry of Personnel, Public Grievances & Pensions, **19 Dec 2024**. URL: [PIB](https://www.pib.gov.in/PressReleasePage.aspx?PRID=2086061). Claim: CPGRAMS reportedly redressed about 70 lakh grievances, mapped over 1 lakh grievance officers, and cut average redress time, which is direct evidence of observable implementation and state reach. QIDs: `8B.6`
- **Cabinet approves the Digital Agriculture Mission today with an outlay of Rs. 2817 Crore...** — Press Information Bureau / Ministry of Agriculture & Farmers Welfare, **2 Sep 2024**. URL: [PIB](https://www.pib.gov.in/Pressreleaseshare.aspx?PRID=2050966&lang=2&reg=48). Claim: the government created a concrete digital agriculture stack with farmer registries, geo-referenced village maps, crop-sown registries, and digital crop surveys, which is stronger than rhetorical “support farmers” messaging. QIDs: `8B.6`
- **Update on Ayushman Bharat Digital Mission** — Press Information Bureau / Ministry of Health and Family Welfare, **17 Dec 2024**. URL: [PIB](https://www.pib.gov.in/Pressreleaseshare.aspx?PRID=2085201&lang=2&reg=48). Claim: ABDM had built large-scale registries and linked tens of millions of health records, indicating institutionalized delivery rather than symbolic health promises. QIDs: `8B.6`
- **India’s Modi spends billions on jobs, key allies in first budget after election** — Reuters via ThePrint, **23 Jul 2024**. URL: [ThePrint](https://theprint.in/india/indias-modi-spends-billions-on-jobs-key-allies-in-first-budget-after-election/2187546/). Claim: the post-election budget allocated large sums for rural programmes and jobs, which is concrete policy execution, but it was also explicitly shaped by coalition bargaining and vote-repair politics. QIDs: `8B.6`

**Counterevidence**
- **Centre notifies fact check unit under PIB to monitor online content** — ThePrint / PTI, **20 Mar 2024**. URL: [ThePrint](https://theprint.in/economy/centre-notifies-fact-check-unit-under-pib-to-monitor-online-content/2008884/). Claim: the government moved to create a fact-check unit for government content, which looks like an information-control apparatus rather than neutral implementation of policy goals. QIDs: `8B.6`
- **India’s Modi calls rivals pro-Muslim as election campaign changes tack** — Reuters via ThePrint, **23 Apr 2024**. URL: [ThePrint](https://theprint.in/india/indias-modi-calls-rivals-pro-muslim-as-election-campaign-changes-tack/2053223/). Claim: Modi shifted into communal, fear-based campaign messaging about Muslims and redistribution, which is closer to propaganda than observable policy implementation. QIDs: `8B.6`
- **India’s poll panel orders Modi’s BJP, opposition Congress to show restraint in campaign** — Reuters via ThePrint, **22 May 2024**. URL: [ThePrint](https://theprint.in/india/indias-poll-panel-orders-modis-bjp-opposition-congress-to-show-restraint-in-campaign/2096809/). Claim: the Election Commission had to formally censure communal campaigning, showing that political rhetoric was not self-constrained and often outpaced substantive governance. QIDs: `8B.6`
- **India hate speech fueled Modi’s election campaign** — Human Rights Watch, **14 Aug 2024**. URL: [HRW](https://www.hrw.org/news/2024/08/14/india-hate-speech-fueled-modis-election-campaign). Claim: HRW described the campaign as reliant on hate speech and intimidation toward minorities, which is strong evidence of slogan/propaganda politics rather than implementation-driven leadership. QIDs: `8B.6`
- **Internet suspended in parts of India’s Manipur as students clash with police** — Reuters via ThePrint, **10 Sep 2024**. URL: [ThePrint](https://theprint.in/india/internet-suspended-in-parts-of-indias-manipur-as-students-clash-with-police/2261451/). Claim: the state’s response in Manipur used curfews and internet/mobile shutdowns, showing state reach, but in a coercive way that undercuts a clean “implemented for public benefit” reading. QIDs: `8B.6`

**Search Gap**
- The strongest pro-implementation evidence is mostly official government reporting, not independent outcome audits.
- I did not find a single independent source that directly validates end-user outcomes for CPGRAMS, Digital Agriculture Mission, or ABDM at scale in 2024; the positive case rests on implementation architecture and reported outputs, while the negative case has stronger external corroboration.
